annotations.title: Remove vocals (split a song into stems)

description: VOCAL REMOVER: a song, voice note, video or video post link split into vocals, an instrumental (everything but the voice), and drums, bass and other, each its own MP3. Up to 10 minutes. Priced by the seconds of sound; dryRun returns the price ('up to' when the length cannot be read first).

audio.description: the song or video: an https / upload_file URL, a post link, or a local path on the CLI

dryRun.description: price only: nothing made, nothing charged

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice
